ranking_model.name: Plackett-Luce independent sequential ranking approximation
ranking_model.strength: Each horse strength equals simulator final win probability; strengths sum to 1.
ranking_model.place: Sum of all ordered top-3 outcomes containing i.
ranking_model.wide: Sum of all ordered top-3 outcomes containing both selected horses.
ranking_model.wakuren: Sum of ordered top-2 horse outcomes whose frames match the selected frame pair; same-frame requires two distinct horses.
ranking_model.sanrenpuku: Sum of all six top-3 orders.
ranking_model.limitation: Finish-order dependence is represented only through without-replacement conditional normalization; no separate place/show latent strength is fitted.

odds_policy.range_selection: odds_min (the collector odds field is also the lower bound) for conservative EV
